setup.baseline: An owned planet with a known scanner and a target at controlled distance.

procedure: Record scanner type/range and detection at each distance.
Place a fleet in orbit and in deep space; record detection.
Research an upgrade and record automatic replacement and cost.
Test a minefield and a cloaked fleet.

documented: Planet scanners have fixed build cost and upgrade automatically when better technology is available (documented-only).
Planet-penetrating scanners see fleets in orbit and planetary statistics; non-penetrating scanners cannot (documented-only).
Minefields are 82% cloaked from non-penetrating scanners (documented-only).

unresolved: Exact scanner range values are in the undecoded table.
